name: bang-film
description: Design AI live-action video — vertical microdrama series, short films, single scenes or trailers — and write the prompts you paste into any AI image and video model. It never generates media: you get a concept, a locked cast and set bible, a shot list, three-panel character sheet prompts, set and prop plate prompts, and eleven-block video prompts, one per 4–30 second generation. Aspect ratio, duration and episode count are always asked, never assumed.
